preconditions.description: GAP-A conversion stack live: the routed cross-candidate range (modulatory_channel_route_range) clears its floor. This is the SAME statistic the within-shortlist argmin consumes -- not a magnitude proxy for it (the V3-EXQ-643 same-statistic rule).

preconditions.name: ARM_0_both_off::fresh_select_sufficiency
preconditions.description: Enough GENUINE selections for an entropy to have an n. The env-step count is not the denominator -- E3 cadence 10 (driven to [5,20] by MECH-093) means ~90-95% of env steps replicate a prior commitment.
preconditions.control: fresh-selection counter over the frozen-policy P2 phase

preconditions.name: ARM_0_both_off::committed_sufficiency
preconditions.description: NON-VACUITY GUARD ON THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION. C2 compares committed_action_entropy across arms, so its DENOMINATOR is the count of COMMITTED fresh selections -- not env steps and not fresh selections. An agent that never commits yields a C2 computed over an empty histogram, which would read as 'tonic has no committed authority' for the wrong reason (nothing was committed) rather than the right one (the argmin is temperature-invariant). Below floor => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT an authority verdict.
preconditions.control: count of fresh selections with last_score_diagnostics['committed']

dv_symmetry_declaration.ARM_1_mech313_only: committed_action_entropy: manipulation IS invariant (uniform temperature = monotone rescaling; argmin order-preserving) -- this is the HYPOTHESIS UNDER TEST, measured not assumed. precommit_entropy: NOT invariant (softmax is temperature-scaled by construction) -- the positive control.
dv_symmetry_declaration.ARM_3_both_on: As ARM_1, replicated in the presence of dACC.
dv_symmetry_declaration.ARM_2_mech260_only: dACC suppression is a PER-CANDIDATE additive penalty (count(c in history)/len), not a broadcast scalar, so it is NOT invariant under the committed argmin. Measurable.
